title: UK Vape Take-Back Information: What Retailers Should Communicate in 2026
primaryKeyword: UK vape take-back information for retailers
searchIntent: Explain, for adult retail audiences, the UK government's public information about waste-vape take-back or alternative collection points.
sourceName: GOV.UK — Electrical waste: retailer and distributor responsibilities
sourceFacts: GOV.UK states that sellers of vapes must take back waste vapes in store or set up an alternative collection point.
The guidance says businesses should keep a record of information given to customers about where to take WEEE.
The Distributor Take Back Scheme conditions and obligations discussed are specific to the UK.
jurisdictionBoundary: Discuss the UK guidance only and remind readers that take-back duties and waste rules differ by location.
prohibitedClaims: Do not state that the UK rule applies worldwide.
Do not provide hazardous-waste handling instructions beyond directing readers to official/local collection requirements.
Do not frame recycling as a product-quality claim.
